purpose: Untimed complete typed results on registered medium and holdout inputs

cases.name: multi_filter
cases.query: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.country = 'CN' AND u.age >= 30 RETURN count(u)

cases.name: ordered_topk
cases.query: MATCH (u:User) RETURN u.id ORDER BY u.score DESC, u.id ASC LIMIT 100

cases.name: full_neighbors
cases.query: MATCH (:User {id: 'user-000001'})-[:FOLLOWS]->(v:User) RETURN v ORDER BY v.id

cases.name: duplicate_missing_gather
cases.query: UNWIND ['user-000003', 'user-000001', 'not-found', 'user-000001'] AS probe OPTIONAL MATCH (u:User {id: probe}) RETURN probe, u.age
